candidates.title: The Last Chapter: Bede on his deathbed completing his translation of St John's Gospel
candidates.evidence: Cambridge University Library says original hangs outside Anderson Room, by permission of Bible Society Trustees. Distinct from National Trust Wallington William Bell Scott Bede painting (1857).
candidates.imageGate: Commons image only 794x628, better master required from custodian; commercial reproduction rights unknown.

candidates.title: Sant'Effremo
candidates.evidence: Francesco Netti's scholarly artist association specifies signed 1892 original, commissioned for Church Madonna della Pietà in Santeramo, stored Bari museum from 1930. A replacement copy by Bartolomeo Paradiso was subsequently stolen. Saint identified as Ephrem Syrian in Santeramo parish historical accounts.
candidates.imageGate: Custodian catalogue/photo permissions and app-quality reproduction pending; portrait iconography possible, separate from Giuseppe Franchi original in prior W30.

nonCounted.title: Death of Ephrem the Syrian
nonCounted.reason: Vatican Museums physically own 17c painting in icon room; an icon-format piece, outside naturalistic-oil aesthetic, therefore reserve as Eastern-icon fallback; do not count toward required 2 naturalistic originals.
